name: promo-helper
description: Shared promotion intelligence — channel scoring, percentile engine, Thompson Sampling, Redis locks, conversion attribution

scripts.typecheck:tests: tsc --noEmit --pretty false --target ES2020 --module CommonJS --moduleResolution node --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --resolveJsonModule --strict true --exactOptionalPropertyTypes true --noUncheckedIndexedAccess true --noPropertyAccessFromIndexSignature true --noImplicitReturns true --noFallthroughCasesInSwitch true --types jest tests/*.ts
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:declarations && npm run build && npm run test:ci
scripts.prepare: node -e "if (process.env.CI) { process.exit(0); } const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const huskyPath = path.join(process.cwd(), 'node_modules', '.bin', 'husky'); if (fs.existsSync(huskyPath)) { require('child_process').execSync('husky', { stdio: 'ignore' }); }"

author: SaiKumar Shetty
